title: Install and qualify NVIDIA SoL-Pi on the canonical node
description: Install the upstream NVIDIA NVlabs/SoL-Pi GitHub extension through the supported Pi package mechanism only; do not patch or vendor Pi. First inspect node state, Node.js, npm, and Pi availability. Require Node.js >=22.19 and tested Pi release @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent@0.85.1 before declaring install qualified. Use the upstream repository git:github.com/NVlabs/SoL-Pi. Prefer project-local installation for the MediaHub project. Run the upstream source checks available from the checkout, install with pi install <absolute-checkout> --approve, verify pi list, validate the effective sol-pi.json with all four mechanisms enabled only if the required provider/model values can be safely configured, and perform an offline Pi startup check with no prompt. Never print or persist secrets. Do not modify upstream Pi source. Publish exact PASS/PARTIAL/BLOCKED evidence including versions, checkout commit, install scope, config path and failed prerequisite if any. This is an installation/qualification task; do not start the 24h soak.
